result.topic_en: The page finishes an argument that builds a generalised Maurer theorem by switching off one-parameter transformations in turn, notes it extends to two forms via their product, and then begins considering a determinant equation built from the particular integrals of a third-order linear differential equation.

items.quote:
Schaltet man dann andre [-T-]
Transformationen aus, und fährt so fort, bis
man die allgemeinste aus Allen diesen Einzelnen
einparametrigen zusammen setzen kann, so hat
man den verallgemeinerten Maurerschen Satz.
items.english: If one then switches off other transformations, and continues in this way until one can compose the most general one out of all these individual one-parameter ones, then one has the generalised Maurer theorem.

items.quote:
Man kann denselben auch auf 2 Formen ver-
allgemeinern, indem man ihn auf das Produkt
der beiden Formen anwendet.
items.english: One can also generalise it to 2 forms by applying it to the product of the two forms.
